title: Pkm Review Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pkm:review
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for pkm review.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag pkm review events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It combines whether your pkm review activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
